tha-ap131:1.1: Gaṇṭhipupphiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sambuddho Vipassī dakkhiṇāraho / purakkhato sāvakehi ārāmā abhinikkhamī. // //
tha-ap131:2.1: Disvān' ahaṃ Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ sabbaññūtam-anāsavaṃ / pasannacitto sumano gaṇṭhipupphaṃ apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap131:3.1: Tena cittappasādena dipadindassa tādino / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena puna vandiṃ *Tathāgataṃ. // //
tha-ap131:4.1: Eka*navute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap131:5.1: Ekatālīs' ito kappe Varaṇo nama khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo. // //
tha-ap131:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Gaṇṭhipupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
